race.comment: Fairly open staying contest where CHIEF LITTLE ROCK (1) can find winning form. Outclassed two back at Flemington then not far away in city grade last time at Sandown Hillside. This much easier and should be at top now. Has the senior aboard and will be tough to stop. The dangers all have a pull in the weights on the topweight. HARLEY'N'ROSE (7) wasn't beaten far here last time and is nicely weighted with the claim. Gets chance to return to best. SMILING ASSASSIN (5) who is a seasoned veteran with solid form course and distance. One of the chances. HIGH SOCIETY GIRL (3) is knocking on the door and doesn't need to improve much to get the job done.
